blocks.text: COTABATO CITY – The Army’s 6th Infantry (Kampilan) Division (6ID) strongly condemned Thursday the killing of two soldiers in a shooting along the national highway in Barangay Ladia, Sultan Kudarat, Maguindanao del Norte, on Wednesday evening. Brig. Gen. Ricky Bunayog, acting commander of the 6ID and Joint Task Force Central (JTFC), described the attack as an “unacceptable and cowardly act of violence.” READ: 2 soldiers slain in Maguindanao del Norte gun attack He vowed to bring the perpetrators to justice, as he called on citizens to help crack the case by providing information to authorities.
